sensor.pinout_source_review: Verified against manufacturer data-sheet Figure 3 / Table 6; dimensional model review continues.
sensor.overforce_note: Not a normal operating range; repeated overforce can permanently damage the sensor.
sensor.teb_scope: Data-sheet qualification is at 5 V and 20–80% FSS; it is not a verified 3.3 V or 0.2 N result.

mechanism.architecture: Four-leaf normal-translation guide, root-mounted original finger, compliant sensor carrier and adjustable overload stops
mechanism.guide_material: 0.50 mm AISI 301 full-hard spring stainless strip; verify supplier temper, measured thickness and flatness
mechanism.sensor_compliance_scope: Illustrative 0–10 µm displacement at 20 N. This is not a manufacturer-guaranteed stroke curve.
mechanism.plunger_contact_material: Polished hardened steel flat pad; inspect contact wear in the pilot
notes: Positive native Z contact reaction presses a flat plunger against a downward-facing sensor sphere.
The sensor is intended at the normal compliance center of the four-leaf guide, reducing ideal moment-to-force coupling.
The compliant backing provides usable motion for the overload stop; stops react against the fixed frame, not the sensor housing.
All finger loads must enter through the floating carrier. Cable forces, real clamps, housing clearance and source finger stiffness remain unqualified.
The 50 mm reach extension is a prototype packaging tradeoff, not an improvement claim.
